display_name: Phase1 structured residual learned-prior blind inverse ground test
description: Fixed evaluation of a DURA-free blind inverse with source structured-residual prior; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
authorization: 用户要求研发不同路线的星地恢复网络，只看 Phase1 地面训练测试、使用 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；六场景下降不超过 3%，同时核对百分点和相对百分比口径。

code.environment: N607 GPU7 fixed inference, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL ground base, TF32 disabled; independent CPU truth-last score

data.representation: Blind action posterior and source-trained denoising prior with three stable observation updates; frozen input gate and F
data.tx_sets_ref: No test truth, clean pair, U_s truth or V during inference; fixed ground test truth after all seven views
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout, previously seen in other source views
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Prior trained from source clean IQ and frozen F soft outputs without TX labels; independent blind source model trained without TX labels; no U_s truth, V or test.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.regime: Source-trained frozen candidate, fixed Phase1 ground test inference then truth-last scoring
permissions.query_use: Per-record received IQ and frozen F predictions only; no clean pair, labels or adaptation at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Previously observed Phase1 single-seed simulated development test, not independent blind or actual satellite.

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source structured-residual SignalPrior, source-only blind channel and Gaussian prior, gate .8; DURA comparator only where applicable.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Independent IQ prior commit 6656dc7d4965b315253124903ebfbfbe1731e32a and blind action source commit 94693a342bb2daa684c0f21415d7b949f9fb2107.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source only; DURA absent from candidate; fixed evaluation before source validation or target results. Prior model training running at registration.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Full 3-step prior-guided candidate, gate .8, fixed before source validation and target prediction; all seven views before truth.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU7 after idle check; source-only real model prediction smoke before test; preserve other owners

metric_names: per-view frozen F raw and restored accuracy
per-view clean-relative percentage point and relative percent gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: All six simulated satellite views at most 3 percentage points and 3% relative below F clean; clean output degradation <=1 percentage point

notes: Evaluation fixed while source prior training was running, before source validation or ground test results.
Candidate uses no DURA architecture, weights, teacher outputs or inference; DURA is source/ground comparator only.
Fixed 3 observation/prior steps: sigma .16/.08/.03, step .8; ground gate .8 irrespective of source validation.
Previously explored source and Phase1 development test; simulated single-seed results do not establish independent blind or actual-satellite performance.
